component.name: Nexum
component.summary: Explore chemistry through calculations, molecular structures and data
Explore química com cálculos, estruturas moleculares e dados

description.p: Nexum is a scientific workbench for chemical calculations, molecular visualization and educational experiments.
The laboratory combines portable projects, data import, molecular editing, analysis workflows, experimental design and reports. Model assumptions and limitations accompany results.
O Nexum reúne cálculos químicos, visualização molecular e experimentos didáticos.
O laboratório integra projetos portáteis, importação de dados, edição molecular, fluxos de análise, planejamento experimental e relatórios. Resultados mostram as hipóteses e limitações do modelo.
Application-wide appearance preference, synchronized molecular views and clearer session controls.
Integrated laboratory, uncertainty and speciation tools, portable projects and macOS packaging preparation.
